verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an authorization endpoint you run yourself: an external-authorizer API to authorize transactions without its Core/Autorizador, and an "endpoint de autorización" configured with its integrators. It also documents a stand-in feature that authorizes on your behalf when your services respond slowly. The evidence is limited to one-line guide summaries and does not show the time budget or how much control you have over the fallback. missing for 10: documented response time budget/timeout value, details of fallback configuration (approve/decline rules you control), self-serve endpoint registration rather than integrator-provisioned setup, request/response schema for the decision, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can approve or decline each authorization in real time — a webhook or auth-stream endpoint my code answers inside the network's time budget, with a documented timeout fallback I control

citations.quote: Autorizar y ajustar transacciones sin usar nuestro Core de crédito o Autorizador.
Mejora tu tasa de aprobación permitiendo que autoricemos transacciones cuando tus servicios demoren en responder.
Un endpoint de autorización configurado con nuestro equipo de integradores.
